about.desc_1: Grizzly is a territory where city noise fades away. We've built a space in Szczecin where century-old traditions meet modern precision. A place to recharge with a premium drink while our masters focus on the most important thing — your image.
about.desc_2: From sharp fades to ritual beard trims, we don't just cut hair; we build confidence. By focusing on your unique anatomy and vibe, we ensure you leave in your best form. Just lean back, enjoy the atmosphere, and let the experts handle the rest.
